publishedModelAliases.reason: Checked 2026-10-15. Those five grades are the inherited mini-countryman BEV record and the five retained mini_countryman_u25_bev versions whose catalogue model label is Countryman Electric. This naming equivalence is limited to that current Australian BEV family and those five reviewed identities; it does not include petrol Countryman, future Untamed or residual E Core, and does not establish physical stock or accepted orders.
